title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 1 November 2026
description: Prime Minister Albanese travels to the Caribbean for the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, Queensland introduces a new permit scheme easing freight costs for farmers, and the Gold Coast council pushes for tougher waterway pollution penalties after a Palm Beach canal incident. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
